newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth customers set for refund.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth customers set for refund.

text.p: BellSouth Corp said on Tuesday its residential customers in Florida will receive in their June bill a refund of between $4.35 and $6.34 per line and business customers will get $11.80 to $17.34 per line.
The refunds, $50.1 million in total based on BellSouth's 1996 results, are part of a profit-sharing agreement agreed in 1994 and approved by the Florida Public Service Commission.

The plan was devised by the Office of Public Counsel which represents the interests of Florida's citizens in Public Service Commission hearings, and will cover BellSouth's results in 1997 too. The plan expires in 1998.
BellSouth has four million customers in Florida.
